aboutMe.title: About Me
aboutMe.paragraph1: Hi! I'm Kuzma, a frontend developer. My specialization is creating complex interfaces with a focus on well-thought-out architecture (<tech>FSD</tech>), rather than just writing code.
aboutMe.paragraph2: I have a Fullstack background: I wrote backend on <tech>Nest.js</tech>, worked with relational databases, and configured monorepositories (<tech>Nx</tech>). Because of this, I understand the entire development lifecycle and speak the same language as backend developers.
aboutMe.paragraph3: I value when a product not only looks attractive but also works fast (<tech>Next.js</tech>, <tech>Core Web Vitals</tech>). For me, it's important to build a reliable foundation that is easy to maintain and scale with the team.

hubnity.title: Hubnity (SaaS Platform)
hubnity.description: A frontend SaaS platform for time tracking, built from scratch as the sole frontend engineer. Features analytics dashboards with interactive charts, virtualized activity logs (stable 60 FPS with 30–40 concurrent users), URL-synced filtering with Zustand + nuqs, and multi-timezone scheduling with DST handling.

inviteKz.title: Invite.kz (SaaS Platform)
inviteKz.description: A Fullstack SaaS platform for creating and managing digital invitations. Built with Nx Monorepo architecture, separating the Editor (Vite) from the Public Viewer (Next.js) for maximum SEO performance and scalability. Includes a drag-and-drop canvas builder, NestJS backend with JWT auth, and full i18n via Google Cloud Translation API.

portfolio.title: Personal Portfolio
portfolio.description: A high-performance personal website built on the bleeding-edge stack (React 19 + Tailwind 4). Serves as a playground for experimenting with advanced animations (Framer Motion), FSD architecture, full i18n (next-intl), and Core Web Vitals optimization.
